ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( DW_Account_Type__c, "Customer Name"), LEN(Phone) > 16, OR( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Phone can only be up to 16 characters.
